blue_card.name: EU Blue Card
blue_card.explanationTemplate: With your {{degreeField}} degree and €{{salary}} offer from {{nationality}}, you may qualify for the EU Blue Card.

skilled_worker.name: Skilled Worker Visa
skilled_worker.explanationTemplate: With your {{degreeField}} qualification and work experience, you're eligible for the Skilled Worker Visa.

it_specialist.name: IT Specialist Visa (Without Degree)
it_specialist.explanationTemplate: Based on your {{experienceYears}} years of IT experience, you qualify for the IT Specialist Visa even without a formal degree.

job_seeker.name: Job Seeker Visa
job_seeker.explanationTemplate: You may qualify for a Job Seeker Visa to search for employment in Germany for up to 6 months.

student.name: Student Visa
student.explanationTemplate: Since you have an admission letter from a German university, you qualify for a Student Visa.

language_course.name: Language Course Visa
language_course.explanationTemplate: Because you plan to attend a full-time German course, you may qualify for a Language Course Visa.

ausbildung.name: Ausbildung (Vocational Training) Visa
ausbildung.explanationTemplate: With a training contract, you may qualify for an Ausbildung visa.

researcher.name: Researcher Visa
researcher.explanationTemplate: You're eligible for a Researcher Visa based on your host agreement with a German institution.

artist.name: Artist/Performer Visa
artist.explanationTemplate: As an artist or performer, you may qualify for a cultural visa.

family_reunion.name: Family Reunion Visa
family_reunion.explanationTemplate: Since you have family in Germany, you may qualify for Family Reunion.

au_pair.name: Au Pair Visa
au_pair.explanationTemplate: You may qualify for an Au Pair Visa to live with a host family.

volunteer_service.name: Volunteer / FSJ Visa
volunteer_service.explanationTemplate: You're eligible for a Volunteer (FSJ/BFD) visa based on your host program contract.
